meta_title: JW Plumbing & Maintenance | Bathroom Renovator Southampton
meta_description: JW Plumbing and Maintenance offer expert bathroom renovations across Southampton. Quality craftsmanship, fixed prices, and a tidy finish guaranteed. Call today.
hero_subhead: Tired of a tired bathroom? JW Plumbing and Maintenance delivers beautiful, fully fitted bathrooms on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Bathroom Renovation Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From full bathroom strip-outs and redesigns to individual upgrades, we handle every aspect of your project with care and expertise.

services.title: Full Bathroom Renovation
services.desc: We manage your bathroom transformation from first fix to final tile, coordinating every trade so you don't have to. The result is a stunning, fully functional bathroom delivered with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Wet Room Installation
services.desc: Professionally tanked and fully waterproofed wet rooms designed to suit your space and lifestyle. Ideal for accessibility needs or a sleek, contemporary look.

services.title: Shower Installation & Replacement
services.desc: From electric showers to thermostatic power showers and frameless enclosures, we supply and fit all types. Old, leaking, or tired units replaced neatly and efficiently.

services.title: Bath Installation
services.desc: Whether you're after a classic freestanding roll-top or a space-saving P-shaped bath, we'll fit it perfectly and connect all plumbing to a clean, watertight finish.

services.title: Tiling & Waterproofing
services.desc: Expert floor and wall tiling using quality adhesives and grouts, with full attention to alignment and grouting finish. Splash-back areas and wet zones properly waterproofed before tiling begins.

services.title: General Plumbing & Maintenance
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaking taps, toilet repairs, and radiator work handled quickly by a qualified local plumber. Reliable, honest service with no hidden call-out charges.

about_pullquote: Every bathroom we fit, we'd be proud to have in our own home.
about_para_1: JW Plumbing and Maintenance was founded and is run by an experienced, qualified plumber based in Calmore, Southampton. Over the years, we've built a strong reputation across Southampton and the surrounding area by doing the simple things exceptionally well — turning up when we say we will, keeping the site clean, and delivering a finish that lasts.
about_para_2: We're a small, owner-operated business, which means you'll deal directly with us from your free quote right through to the day we hand back your keys. No subcontractors, no surprises — just honest advice, quality materials, and workmanship we stand behind.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About JW Plumbing

reviews.text: Jay completely transformed our family bathroom — from stripping the old suite to tiling and fitting the new one. Arrived on time every day, kept everything clean and tidy, and the finish is absolutely immaculate. Couldn't recommend him highly enough.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Used JW Plumbing for a new shower enclosure and full retile. The quality of the tiling is superb and the job was done quicker than expected. Very reasonable price and no messing about. Will definitely be calling Jay again for our en suite.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Jay gave us a clear quote, stuck to it, and the new bathroom looks fantastic. He was respectful of our home throughout and cleaned up perfectly every evening. Exactly what you want from a local tradesman.
reviews.author: Rachel H.

address_sub: Serving Southampton and surrounding areas including Totton, Calmore, Dibden, and the New Forest
emergency_banner_text: Burst pipe or urgent plumbing problem? We aim to respond to Southampton call-outs the same day. Call now —
